sample_rule: Deterministic cross-era structural sample selected without using any return/PCR-performance outcome. Dates cover legacy OSE PDF, transition-era Osaka Exchange PDF, modern Osaka Exchange PDF, and current JPX archive.

samples.reason: legacy OSE layout before known 2010-06 archive gap
known sparse-glyph legacy/transition parser edge case

required_checks_per_sample: Official report is retrievable from the frozen source reference.
Reference Nikkei 225 close is parsed from the same report.
At least two standard monthly Nikkei 225 option maturities are parsed.
Both PUT and CALL issue rows are parsed for near and second-near maturities.
Nearest-OTM selected put strike is strictly below reference close.
Nearest-OTM selected call strike is strictly above reference close.
Selected volume is numeric and nonnegative.
Parser records Auction and J-NET separately where present.
No manual row correction is used.
global_pass_rule: 9/9 samples must pass all structural checks. Any parser failure is DATA_INCONCLUSIVE until an objectively identified parser implementation defect is fixed without changing PCR information rules or QA sample dates.
forbidden: Replace a failing QA date after seeing parser output.
Use JNU/Nikkei future returns or PCR predictive performance in parser decisions.
Manually patch an individual option volume into the derived panel.
Drop J-NET or Auction only because one layout is harder to parse.
Change nearest-OTM, maturity, or five-business-day rules to obtain parser PASS.
